Both people need FlySafeSMS and must allow location sharing for each other in FlySafe.

From the friends list, you can send two SMS request types:
• GPS (fresh location): tries to get a new fix (up to ~2 minutes)
• Last known: returns the latest cached location immediately

Last known can be old (minutes, hours, or older) if Android has no newer fix.

Fresh GPS can fail indoors (no sky view) and then no reply is sent to avoid battery drain.

The TIME in the reply SMS is the location fix timestamp, not the SMS send time.

To reply when app is in background:
• Location permission: Allow all the time
• Battery optimization: set FlySafeSMS to Don't optimize

On many phones, battery optimization blocks background GPS/SMS behavior even if permissions are granted.

When sending requests, recipient phone comes from friend profile data.\n\nYour own number should be set correctly in your profile so others can reach you. If your number changes, update it from this app menu (My phone number) and it will be saved to server profile.

Older FlySafe flow embedded a reply phone in SMS body due to Android SmsRetriever limitations. Current Flow uses sender phone directly for replies; embedded phone is kept only for backward compatibility.
